title: Installment Structure of a Pocketwire Pay in 4 Plan
content:
## Terms

Each Pocketwire Pay in 4 plan divides the purchase into the tier's number of installments, due every installment interval of calendar days from the purchase date. The first installment, which is the tier's down-payment share of the purchase, is collected at checkout. Cents that do not divide evenly are placed according to the tier's rounding rule. The tier's plan fee is charged, and there is no interest.

## Schedule of installment terms

| Tier | Installments per plan (the one paid at purchase included) | Calendar days between due dates | Down payment collected at checkout | Placement of cents that do not divide evenly | Plan fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | 4 | 14 | 25.00 percent of the purchase | The first installment absorbs the cents | 0.00 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | 4 | 14 | 25.00 percent of the purchase | The first installment absorbs the cents | 0.00 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | 4 | 14 | 25.00 percent of the purchase | The first installment absorbs the cents | 0.00 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | 4 | 14 | 25.00 percent of the purchase | The first installment absorbs the cents | 0.00 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier | 4 | 14 | 25.00 percent of the purchase | The first installment absorbs the cents | 0.00 |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | 4 | 14 | 25.00 percent of the purchase | The first installment absorbs the cents | 0.00 |

No Pocketwire Pay in 4 plan carries interest on any tier.

## How the installments are set

- **Due dates.** The first installment falls on the purchase date and is collected at checkout. Each later installment falls due 14 calendar days after the one before it, so on every tier the four installments fall on the purchase date and on the 14th, 28th and 42nd calendar day after it.
- **Amounts.** With four installments and a down payment of 25.00 percent, each installment is an even quarter of the purchase. The purchase amount in cents is divided by the number of installments; every installment receives the whole number of cents of that even share, and the cents left over — never more than three with four installments — are added to the first installment.
- **At checkout.** The first installment is recorded as paid on the purchase date by autopay from the linked debit card.

## Worked split (hypothetical purchase dated day 0)

A purchase of USD 250.03 is 25003 cents. Divided by four it gives 6250 whole cents each, with 3 cents left over.

| Installment | Due | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Day 0, collected at checkout | 62.53 |
| 2 | Day 14 | 62.50 |
| 3 | Day 28 | 62.50 |
| 4 | Day 42 | 62.50 |

The four installments total USD 250.03, the purchase amount; the plan fee of USD 0.00 adds nothing and no interest is added.

A purchase of USD 200.00 divides evenly: four installments of USD 50.00 each, the first collected at checkout.
